projects.title: Hidden Mickeys
projects.description:
As an avid Disney goer and Scavenger Hunt enthusiast, I wanted an app that I could take into the park with me and be able to enjoy a new Scavenger Hunt of different Hidden Mickeys located throughout the parks.

This app follows the CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) method. So it gives the user the opportunity to View all the Hidden Mickeys based on the Park and Area of the Park they choose. The user also has the opportunity to Add new Hidden Mickeys, Update the info on incorrect Hidden Mickeys, and Delete Hidden Mickeys that are no longer located in the Parks.

The following technologies were used:

The back-end was an API that was developed in C# using LINQ with Entity Framework.

The front-end was a React app that fetched data from the API and support multiple pages with React Router.

GitHub for Code: https://github.com/MandyW0312/HiddenMickey

Following technologies used:

React

APIs
JavaScript Fetch Quick Reference
Two Dimensional Arrays in React
